name: Life Tracker
subtitle: The Life Tracker app, straight from its repo

apps.name: Life Tracker
apps.subtitle: Your Google Sheet, as a native app
apps.localizedDescription: Your day, your habits and the long things, in one place. Today, Tomorrow and Yesterday with drag-to-reorder, habits with streaks and a month grid, a journey with a reverse countdown and daily proof photos, goals, body log, notes and the log. Subscribes your timed tasks to Apple or Google Calendar, reminds you before one starts, and puts the day on your home and lock screens.
apps.versionDescription: Add box sits on top of the list and new tasks land first. Sort the day: my order, newest, oldest, by time, A to Z. Quieter when the server hiccups.
